# Village of Poultney municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 18; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 269 (Village of Poultney): sections 302(a) and 303(b): a Village President is elected at the annual village meeting from among the trustees, and under section 502(d) the President is chairman of the Board of Trustees; under section 302(d) the President also serves as Village Moderator, so no separate moderator post is created. The only roster naming a president rests on a restricted clerk reply and a second public source styles the same man Vice-Chair, so the post is created without a membership

offices.title: Village Trustee
offices.org_name: Village of Poultney Board of Trustees

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 269 (Village of Poultney): section 303: five trustees, two elected each year to two-year terms

Town and Village of Poultney Merger Study, Project Steering Committee page (CGR, the municipalities' merger-study consultant): lists 'Joe DeBonis, Village Trustees, Vice-Chair', 'Idris Atwood, Village Trustees', and 'Gerri Harrison, Village Trustees' as the village's representatives, corroborating the three as sitting trustees in 2026. Two further trustees (Bonnie Gray and Ben Worthing) rest only on a restricted clerk-reply roster, so their seats are created without memberships; the minting of the three corroborated trustees as elected is flagged on issue #163

24 App. V.S.A. ch. 269 (Village of Poultney): sections 302(a) and 304(a): a single combined Village Clerk/Treasurer office, elected for a one-year term. The only source naming the current holder rests on a restricted clerk reply, so the post is created without a membership

24 App. V.S.A. ch. 269 (Village of Poultney): section 304(b): three auditors on staggered three-year terms, one elected each year. No official source publishes the current holders, so the post is created without memberships
